name: Donnelley Foundation: South Carolina Lowcountry Land Conservation Grants
summary: Grants of typically $10,000 to $100,000 for land conservation in eleven South Carolina Lowcountry counties, with a focus on climate resilience, advocacy and inclusive conservation. Developed parklands, gardens and trails are not funded.

geography.label: South Carolina Lowcountry: Horry, Georgetown, Berkeley, Dorchester, Charleston, Colleton, Hampton, Jasper, Williamsburg, Marion and Beaufort counties

eligibility.rule: A 501(c)(3) public charity, fiscally sponsored by one, or a unit of government
In compliance with the Secretary of State where the organisation is headquartered
Completed at least one full fiscal year of operations before applying
No environmental education programmes or religious activities
No political campaigns, electoral politics or lobbying on pending legislation
No stand-alone conferences, publications, films, events, websites or videos
No endowments, capital campaigns or debt reduction
No developed parklands, community, school or rain gardens, green roofs, permeable pavements, trails or bike paths

documents: Secretary of State compliance confirmation (a screenshot is fine)
Fiscal sponsorship agreement, if fiscally sponsored
List of current board members, with officers marked
Financials (audit, 990 or internal figures) for the last two completed fiscal years
Current-year organisation budget with year-to-date actuals
Bank letter or voided check to confirm ACH payment details

steps: Conversation with the Lowcountry programme director (new applicants)

calls.label: Deadline 26 March 2027
calls.note: New applicants must speak with a program officer before applying.

applicant_types.quote: You must be a 501(c)(3) public charity (or be fiscally sponsored by one) or unit of government.

geography.quote: You must have a nexus to land conservation in the following counties: Horry, Georgetown, Berkeley, Dorchester, Charleston, Colleton, Hampton, Jasper, Williamsburg, Marion, and Beaufort.

access.quote: New applicants must speak with Jason Crowley before beginning the application process.

amount.quote: Typical grants range from $10,000-$100,000 in the Lowcountry Land Conservation portfolio.
